verdicts.evidence: 10-seed runs with K=3, n_k=2000 show MDCP worst-case coverage of 0.905 (classification) and 0.909 (regression), both clearing the 0.90 nominal level; max-p baseline over-covers (0.944/0.939) and single-source collapses (0.894/0.327), matching expected behavior.

500 finite-alphabet LP instances (3 sources, 24 outcomes) solved via linprog show max primal-dual gap 2.23e-8, max complementary-slackness error 2.23e-8, max superlevel-structure violation 1.26e-8, with 500/500 instances having at least one active source and boundary randomization exercised.

Convergence study across 8 sample sizes (100–25,000) with 20 seeds shows shared-score error dropping from 3.92 to 0.392 (Spearman −1.000) and calibrated-set symmetric difference from 18.45 to 1.80, within the oracle boundary measure of 3; frozen-weight destructive control yields 2.34× worse error, confirming the consistency assumption is load-bearing.

Fitted-lambda reduction measured at 4.73% (SE 1.68) vs claimed 34.39%; even a cheating oracle constant-lambda search achieves only 13.49% — far below the claim — but a documented optimizer deviation (full-batch Adam vs paper's minibatch with early stopping) remains unresolved as a confound.

Fitted-lambda reduction measured at 8.71% (SE 1.85) vs claimed 22.44%; oracle constant-lambda achieves 11.91%, still well below the claim; same unresolved optimizer deviation applies, and the official 100-trial panel was not completed.
No FMoW images, DenseNet-121 checkpoint, or six-region artifacts were used; the logbook explicitly states the FMoW claim was not attempted.

overall: The logbook provides concrete numerical evidence supporting the three theoretical claims (Theorems 1–3) through empirical coverage tests, LP/KKT audits, and convergence studies with destructive controls. The two empirical efficiency claims (34.39% and 22.44% reductions) are not reproduced — measured reductions are far below claimed values — but an unresolved optimizer deviation prevents a definitive falsification, and the FMoW claim was not attempted at all.
